events.description: Randolph and Mortimer PiCreatures appear at the bottom, followed by a 10x10 grid of integers from 1 to 100 fading in at the top.

events.description: 10 random numbers in the grid are highlighted with teal rectangles, while the rest of the grid is dimmed.

events.description: The 10 selected numbers are rearranged into a 2x5 grid above the PiCreatures, and the original grid fades out.

events.description: Two subsets of the 10 numbers are highlighted, and an equation showing their equal sums is displayed at the top.
